// Positive cases for the non-React surfaces. Scanned as a virtual .ts path.
export const TOOL = {
  id: 'measure-tool',
  icon: 'straighten',
  label: 'Measure distance',
  tooltip: 'Pick two points',
  description: 'Measures between snap points.',
};

export function draw(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, mode: string, value: number) {
  ctx.fillText('AR Navigation', 10, 20);
  ctx.fillText(mode === 'ar' ? 'Start AR' : 'Start VR', 10, 40);
  ctx.fillText(String(value), 10, 60);
}

export function status(el: HTMLElement, count: number) {
  el.textContent = 'Connection lost';
  el.textContent = `Loaded ${count} drives`;
}

export function fail(): never {
  throw new Error('Snap point is already occupied');
}

export function report(setMessage: (v: string) => void, setBusyFlag: (v: string) => void) {
  setMessage('Close the project before deleting it.');
  setBusyFlag('running');
}

export function fmt(value: number, locale: string) {
  return [
    value.toLocaleString(),
    value.toLocaleString(locale),
    new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(value),
  ].join(' ');
}
